decisions.question: S137 read 'that phase or an earlier one delivers what a case calls' as the phase's dependency closure (D5 runs .12 and .13 side by side), which also drops G3 and G7 from nidana.model.13's restriction; number order would keep them, since this run executes serially. Accept?

options.label: Accept the dependency-closure reading
options.consequence: .13's gate is right whichever of .12 and .13 merges first, as the plan allows; G3 and G7 run at .12 and at .14's unrestricted replay.

options.label: Number order
options.consequence: .13's gate passes only if .12 merged first, which D5 does not require.

decisions.why: D5 is the governance; a gate that depends on execution order the plan leaves free is a latent defect of the same class this amend fixes.
